# Golden CO Painters (Painter Hotline)

> Painter Hotline's Golden crew paints and stains homes in Golden, CO and the foothills (Evergreen, Conifer, Idaho Springs, Lookout Mountain, Genesee): exterior painting for high-altitude sun, cedar and log siding staining, decks and fences, historic district homes and interior painting through winter.

Business: Painter Hotline (Denver-headquartered painting company with specialist crews). Phone: 720-208-5645. Email: quote@painterhotline.com. Company site: https://painterhotline.com/
Trust: fully insured; 20+ years of experience; 5-year workmanship warranty; free virtual (photo) or in-person estimates; paints with all major brands (Sherwin-Williams, Benjamin Moore, Behr, Valspar, PPG).
Current offer: 25% off labor on all painting projects booked by December 31, 2026; paint and materials not included.
